Title: System topics are now an Azure resource

Body.Content:
Explicitly create system topics using Azure Event Grid. Previously, a system topic was implicit and wasn't exposed for simplicity. With this new update, system topics are visible as an Azure resource and these additional capabilities are now available:

  • Manage system topics
  • Manage event subscriptions for system topics
  • Set up diagnostic logs for system topics
  • Set up alerts on publish and delivery metrics

Learn more.
